mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 76 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park, though the air quality index is currently elevated at 52.

The City Clerk's office reports that the I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students is now closed, with public voting set to run from July 28 through August 7 to determine the designs for the November election. Additionally, as we look toward winter, please remember that the city has specific mailbox damage policies for snow plowing incidents, and you should reach out to Public Works if you have any questions about USPS specifications.

There is a lot of local fun on the horizon with live music happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a review of police activity, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a vehicle was found stuck on a large rock; the driver, a 36-year-old man, was arrested for a first offense O-W-I.
It is a sweet day to be in Verona because the flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. The store is open until 10:30 PM, so make sure to stop by and get yours before they close tonight.
